relevance_reason: The paper reports a family with congenital atrial standstill: an SCN5A mutation together with Cx40 polymorphisms, plus a functional characterization of the mutant channel.

findings.statement: Makita et al. (2005) described an 11-year-old boy with an apparently sporadic case of congenital atrial standstill. His surface ECG showed no P waves, and pacing could not capture his right atrium. His father, who carried the same SCN5A mutation, was in normal sinus rhythm.
quotes: The proband had no P waves on surface ECG, and his right atrium could not be captured by pacing.
The novel SCN5A mutation L212P was identified in the proband (age 11 years) and his father. The father was in normal sinus rhythm.

phenotypes.text: right atrium not capturable by pacing

findings.statement: In a boy with congenital atrial standstill, Makita et al. (2005) identified a novel SCN5A mutation, L212P, which he had inherited from his father, who was in normal sinus rhythm. In a heterologous expression system studied by whole-cell patch clamp, the L212P sodium channel showed large hyperpolarizing shifts in the voltage dependence of both activation (-63.5 vs -48.1 mV) and inactivation (-95.6 vs -86.6 mV), as well as delayed recovery from inactivation.
quotes: The novel SCN5A mutation L212P was identified in the proband (age 11 years) and his father.

The recombinant L212P Na channel showed a large hyperpolarizing shift in both the voltage dependence of activation (WT: -48.1 +/- 0.9 mV; L212P: -63.5 +/- 1.5 mV; P < .001) and inactivation (WT: -86.6 +/- 0.9 mV; L212P: -95.6 +/- 0.8 mV; P < .001) and delayed recovery from inactivation.

findings.statement: Makita et al. (2005) found that the proband with atrial standstill, but not his unaffected father who also carried the SCN5A L212P mutation, carried connexin-40 (Cx40) polymorphisms inherited from his asymptomatic mother. The authors suggested that coinheritance of Cx40 polymorphisms is a possible genetic factor that modifies the clinical manifestation of atrial standstill, which is consistent with digenic inheritance and incomplete penetrance.
quotes: Further screenings for genetic variations that might mitigate L212P dysfunction revealed that the proband, but not his father, carries Cx40 polymorphisms inherited from his asymptomatic mother.
Coinheritance of Cx40 polymorphisms is a possible genetic factor that modifies the clinical manifestation of this inherited arrhythmia.

findings.statement: Fazelifar et al. (2005) reported a family with atrial standstill associated with syncope, dilated cardiomyopathy, and sudden cardiac death.
quotes: This report represents a family with atrial standstill associated with syncope, dilated cardiomyopathy, and sudden cardiac death.

findings.statement: Fazelifar et al. (2005) noted that atrial standstill is an extremely uncommon arrhythmia that rarely appears to be familial, and that it has been associated with conditions including congenital heart disease, valvular heart disease, conduction disturbances, Brugada syndrome, myocardial infarction, and amyloidosis.
quotes: Atrial standstill is an extremely uncommon arrhythmia that rarely appears to be familial and genetically determined.

Atrial standstill has been associated with several conditions including, but not restricted to, congenital heart disease, valvular heart disease, conduction disturbances, Brugada syndrome, myocardial infarction, and amyloidosis.

relevance_reason: Reports a large family with familial atrial standstill and the SCN5A D1275N mutation co-inherited with a rare GJA5 (Cx40) genotype, which is the basis of the ATRST1 entry.

findings.statement: Groenewegen et al. (2003) clinically evaluated 44 members of a large family with atrial standstill. One deceased and three living relatives were unambiguously affected by atrial standstill; all other relatives appeared unaffected.
quotes: Forty-four family members were clinically evaluated. One deceased and three living relatives were unambiguously affected by AS. All other relatives appeared unaffected.

findings.statement: In a large family with atrial standstill, Groenewegen et al. (2003) used candidate gene screening to identify a novel SCN5A mutation, D1275N, in all 3 affected living relatives and in 5 unaffected relatives; the deceased affected relative was an obligate carrier. SCN5A-D1275N channels showed a small depolarizing shift in activation compared with wildtype channels.
quotes: Candidate gene screening revealed a novel mutation in the cardiac sodium channel gene SCN5A (D1275N) in all three affected living relatives and in five unaffected relatives, and the deceased relative was an obligate carrier.
SCN5A-D1275N channels showed a small depolarizing shift in activation compared with wild-type channels.

findings.statement: Groenewegen et al. (2003) also detected 2 closely linked polymorphisms in regulatory regions of the atrial-specific gap junction gene connexin-40 (Cx40; GJA5), at nucleotides -44 (G-A) and +71 (A-G). Eight relatives were homozygous for both polymorphisms, a genotype found in only about 7% of controls, and 3 of these were affected. Reporter gene analysis showed reduced expression with the rare Cx40 genotype compared with the more common genotype.
quotes: two closely linked polymorphisms were detected within regulatory regions of the gene for the atrial-specific gap junction protein connexin40 (Cx40) at nucleotides -44 (G-->A) and +71 (A-->G).
Eight relatives were homozygous for both polymorphisms, which occurred in only approximately 7% of control subjects, and three of these relatives were affected by AS.
Rare Cx40 genotype reporter gene analysis showed a reduction in reporter gene expression compared with the more common Cx40 genotype.

findings.statement: Groenewegen et al. (2003) found that the 3 living patients with atrial standstill were the only relatives who coinherited both the rare homozygous Cx40 genotype and the SCN5A D1275N mutation. They proposed that, although each genetic change alone had a relatively benign functional effect, the combined effect eventually progressed to total atrial standstill.
quotes: The three living AS patients exclusively coinherited both the rare Cx40 genotype and the SCN5A-D1275N mutation.
We propose that, although the functional effect of each genetic change is relatively benign, the combined effect of genetic changes eventually progresses to total AS.
